validation_for_selection: Last 8 public observations, used only to choose between structural proposal and flexible fallback; refit on all 16 after selection
heldout: 32 private responses per world for final scoring only
correct_proposal: Three positive Gaussian radial sources, source count supplied by descriptive metadata; centers selected from high-response public observations and nonnegative weights fitted numerically
wrong_proposal: One positive Gaussian radial source, a deliberately false source-count description
fallback: Isotropic RBF kernel ridge with output centering
hyperparameters: Proposal widths 0.3/0.6/1.2 and fallback widths 0.2/0.5/1/2 with ridge penalties 0.01/0.1/1, all selected by leave-one-out squared error on the first 8 public observations only
gate: Use the proposal if its mean absolute error on the last 8 public observations is strictly below fallback mean absolute error; otherwise use fallback. Refit both candidates on all 16 with frozen hyperparameters before heldout forecasting.
primary_metric: 32-query heldout mean absolute error for correct proposal, wrong proposal, fallback, and both gated conditions
interpretation: Numerical functional development test on three previously scored worlds. It cannot establish semantic LM value or general reliability; a pass only justifies a separately frozen fresh-world test.
forbidden: No private heldout response or source location in fitter, no Azure or other closed-source model API
